title: SQLens remediation payload, version 1
description: The machine-readable fix template that rides beside a finding. Material for an agent to apply, never something this tool executes: no field names a path, a command or an execution. A reader that meets a HIGHER schema_version than it understands must ignore the payload rather than guess at it; within a version, unknown keys may be ignored, because fields are only ever added, never removed or renamed.

stability.description: Constant for the whole version-1 line. Not a field a producer chooses.

rule_id.description: Which rule this fixes, so a payload lifted out of a finding still says what it is about.

strategy.description: The named safe sequence. `none` is a conclusion — this rule looked and there is no safe standard sequence — and is not the same as an absent payload, which says only that nobody wrote one.

debt_kind.description: The debt this sequence deliberately leaves open between its steps, in the ledger's own vocabulary — absent for almost every sequence. A pattern like `not_valid_then_validate` is correct and incomplete at the same moment, and naming the account it opens is what stops a half-applied fix from becoming a silent, permanent one.

preconditions.description: Translation keys for what must hold BEFORE step one. A sequence whose preconditions nobody checked is a sequence that fails halfway.

steps.description: The safe sequence, sorted by `order`. The order is the safety property: a sequence applied out of order is not a slower fix, it is a different and usually broken one.

kind.description: WHERE the step belongs. The difference between `migration_statement` and `separate_migration` is the difference between a sequence that works and one that deadlocks on its own transaction.

note_key.description: A translation key, never a sentence: prose here would make every payload a translation unit and the same fix would drift into as many wordings as there are locales.

sql_template.description: Named placeholders `{{table}}`, `{{column}}`, `{{index}}`, filled deterministically from the finding's own context. Never generated, never guessed.

within_transaction.description: FALSE is the load-bearing value: CONCURRENTLY and its relatives fail inside a transaction, so a reader who assumes the default gets a sequence that cannot run.

verification.description: Translation key for how to confirm it worked — the step an agent skips, and the reason this package re-verifies afterwards.
